title: What if Bukele accidentally fell into a black hole?

scenes.narrationText: Bukele just made the worst mistake of his life: accidentally falling into a black hole.
At first, everything seems like a space nightmare. The stars deform, light curves, and space appears completely distorted.
And no, a black hole is not a giant vacuum cleaner. Its gravity is so intense that it curves space-time itself.
Then he crosses the event horizon. That is the point of no return: not even light can escape once it passes through.
But here comes the strange part: if the black hole is big enough, he could cross that limit without noticing anything special at that moment.
From Earth, it would seem he slows down and gets darker and darker. But for him, his clock keeps advancing normally.
As he approaches the center, gravity pulls much harder on his feet than on his head. His body would start stretching like spaghetti.
Finally, in the classical model, he would approach the singularity, where our current theories no longer adequately describe what happens.
So no, there would be no speech, no helicopter, no rescue operation that could get him out of there. Once that horizon is crossed, there is no way back.
